recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Bio: Marty Leeds is a gematria researcher, author and preacher who founded The Gnostic Church and Academy of Lord Jesus Christ in 2022, where he serves as head teacher and spiritual leader. A working minister since 2011, he is the author of more than ten books, among them the Pi & The English Alphabet series, Scripture in the Stars, The Keys to the Tarot and Gnosticism Defined: The Tenets of The Order, built around a mathematical cipher he says is hidden beneath the English alphabet. His teaching centers on Prisca Theologia, the idea of a single wisdom underlying the world's religions, drawing together gematria, Kabbalah, astrology and comparative mythology. He streams weekly sermons free through the Gnostic Academy's YouTube and Rumble channels.
recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Name: Marty Leeds

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Gnosis Without the Boogeyman", "body": "Chance Garton opens by separating real gnosis from what he calls pop culture Gnosticism, the prison planet story in which a demiurge monster gobbles up souls and nature is somehow fake, an idea he hears repeated in materialist simulation theory. Marty Leeds agrees the term carries too much baggage and defines Gnosticism as a way of deconstructing religious texts and spiritual ideas through mystical insight that still has verifiability, which he calls pursuing the science behind spirituality. He says he understood nothing about the world's religions until he brought the esoteric and metaphysical to them, and then they simply started blooming."}, {"title": "Numbers as Proof of God", "body": "For Marty, numbers prove God because they are literally metaphysical: the number seven exists nowhere in the material world and yet is everywhere at once, carrying its own qualities and geometry. A three, four, five right triangle holds true regardless of language, religion or opinion, which he takes as evidence of design behind creation. Every science, from weighing a dog at a vet to architecture, begins with math, yet few mathematicians ever ask what the medium is. Chance adds that materialist culture made numbers purely quantitative, and he frames creation as an infinite journey back to God, like the Fibonacci sequence approaching the golden mean without ever arriving."}, {"title": "Sacred Math Wrapped Around a Lie", "body": "Marty argues that math is the one medium that lets anyone check whether they are being lied to, and that walls of theoretical equations are just theories built on theories. In a video on squaring the circle, he traced that occult art from Nuwa and Fuxi to the Buddhist stupa and the Freemasonic square and compasses, then showed it proportioning official figures such as a 2,160 mile moon that no one has measured. Evil cannot create, he says, so it wraps itself in sacred symbols like the all-seeing eye until seekers flee from them. Chance likens the method to a mousetrap baited with alchemical truth."}, {"title": "Natural Law and the Armor of Faith", "body": "The conversation casts the Gnostic approach as dangerous to churches and political systems, because it answers questions like the meaning of Revelation and leaves a person untethered: if God is your author, you follow natural law. Marty wrote The Unanimous Redeclaration of We the People, an update of the Declaration of Independence paired with an affidavit of status, and says his religious exemption letters worked for everyone who reported back but one. Chance insists God-given rights are inherent rather than granted, calls that grounding the armor of faith, and argues a real conversion to truth is one way because lies need constant maintenance and die under their own details."}, {"title": "Christ Beyond the Garment", "body": "Marty calls the Bible's stories transcendental: read on literal, moral, allegorical and anagogical levels, each is a hub with biological, astrotheological and sacred geometric spokes, so the crucifixion stays relevant across all time. Chance offers one spoke, the cross as a post where a paper legal personhood is nailed up and killed. Introducing his roughly 600 page book Lord Jesus Christ, Marty presents Christ as the primordial man and the eternal present, as incorruptible as the number seven whether spelled seven or sieben, with the name as a garment. Chance likens this to the Tao, and Marty closes on the biggest conspiracy, making people forget what Earth is."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Marty Leeds decodes the gematria of Christ, explains how mathematics proves God more verifiably than any other medium, and lays out his vision for a Gnostic Academy that removes the boogeyman from sacred knowledge and restores the empowering truth behind it.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Marty's first InnerVerse appearance covers gematria and mathematics as a metaphysical language of divine intelligence, why numbers prove God where other mediums fail, how the powers of darkness wrap themselves in sacred symbology to keep seekers away from it, squaring the circle as the sacred theorem used to proportion the heliocentric deception, Christ as the incorruptible logos equivalent to the Dao, the transcendental nature of biblical stories across four levels of interpretation, Marty's natural law legal declarations, and his upcoming book Lord Jesus Christ.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Garments Over a Universal Mystery", "body": "Chance frames the question every researcher of the occult runs into: are the world's many sun gods and solar cults repackaged sorcery meant to trick us, or the organic emergence of one transcendental idea, the way, that almost no human being has lived without? Marty answers that his new book treats it as a universal mystery religion built into nature itself, as accessible as the Belt of Orion or the number 28, and argues occultists hijacked it by turning a living presence into a man from 2,000 years ago to be worshipped. Chance adds that idolatry leaves you idle."}, {"title": "The Second Coming Happens Within", "body": "Asked whether the return of Christ is a personal rapture, and whether fallen angels overlap with modern alien lore, Marty keeps it internal: St. John in Revelation is looking up into the stars and reflecting what is happening within him, and Christ arrives inside you rather than on a historical timeline. He admits he sees little UFO imagery in ancient art. His sharper point is that literalism robs believers of responsibility, leaving them waiting for someone else to fix a broken world while the central doctrine, Christ arising within, gets turned into an external event."}, {"title": "Angels as Angles, Gods as Numbers", "body": "Marty insists myths are never whimsical fabrications. The nine orders of the Christian angelic hierarchy, he says, are angles, which is to say the numbers one through nine. The Egyptian Ennead works the same way, with Nun as nothingness or zero and Atum as one, and the Norse creation story opens on the void of Ginnungagap before a tree of nine levels grows from it. Even Ymir suckling a cow makes sense once you look at Taurus. His method is to place the numbers and constellations in front of a myth first, then read it."}, {"title": "Thoth, the Septenary, and 42", "body": "Chance brings up the Emerald Tablets, where Thoth numbers the seven beings in the Halls of Amenti from three to nine. Marty reads it geometrically: zero, one and two enclose no space, so three is the first number that can form a triangle, and stopping at nine points to the base ten system. Three through nine sums to 42, as does 13 plus 14 plus 15, which he ties to pi, and Matthew counts 42 generations to Jesus split into three fourteens. He defends the septenary cipher with the 28 phalanges of the hands, one through seven added together."}, {"title": "The Name That Carries the Mysteries", "body": "Marty explains that after outlining his new book, covering squaring the circle, doubling the cube, number lines and cosmology, he stepped back and realized he could explain every topic through the name Lord Jesus Christ. Language, he says, has always been the medium of the mysteries, from the Hebrew alphabet to Odin hanging upside down on Yggdrasil to receive the magical alphabet. Chance notes that Lord and God each total 13 in septenary, making 26, the value of Yod Heh Vav Heh. Marty concludes no human mind concocted this, and since history cannot be known, he reverse engineered the structure instead."}]
